PGHOST.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service (private domain). The entrypoint composes DATABASE_URL from this and the other PG* vars, defaulting to port 5432.

PGUSER.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service.

PGPASSWORD.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service.

PGDATABASE.description: Automatically wired from the PostgreSQL companion service.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string composed from companion postgres refs. No port segment: Railway private networking for Postgres always listens on 5432 (the client default).

JWT_SECRET.description: REQUIRED — a random string used to sign JWT tokens. This placeholder auto-generates one for you. Do not reuse an existing secret.

ALLOW_REGISTER.description: Optional — whether to allow new user registration. Set to 'true' to allow sign-ups, 'false' (default) to disable after initial setup.

ALLOW_OPENAPI.description: Optional — whether to expose the OpenAPI documentation endpoint. Defaults to 'true'.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional — the public URL of this Tianji instance, auto-filled from the Railway domain.

WEBSITE_ID.description: Optional — website ID for Tianji's own analytics self-tracking.

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: Optional — ClickHouse HTTP endpoint for tianji's survey/telemetry backend, e.g. http://clickhouse:8123. Leave empty to skip ClickHouse migrations.
